raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on a misleading DuckDuckGo snippet for “Napoléon Alexandre Berthier, 2nd Prince of Wagram” that incorrectly listed his parents (naming Nicolas Joseph Clary), and did not open the article to verify. This introduced a false contradiction into the lineage and risked leading to an incorrect conclusion. Subsequent steps showed repetition (reopening the 1st Prince’s page) instead of verifying the 2nd and 3rd Princes’ pages as instructed, failing to resolve the discrepancy.
